title: aspidium manilense
intro: Aspidium manilense, commonly known as the Manila fern, is a type of fern species. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. Aspidium manilense is known to exhibit therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium manilense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
